title: Personal connections
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:15Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-20T12:25:45Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank point teaches First Nations connection to Country, which is about belonging to land and culture, while the new point is about everyday personal links with family and friends through in-person contact, phone, online and across countries, so it is a different idea.

draft.title: Personal connections
card: A personal connection is a link between people who know each other, such as family and friends. It is a link between people, not between businesses or places.
People connect in person, when they meet face to face. They also connect at a distance, by phone call, text message and video call.
Online tools, such as messaging apps and video calls, let people keep in touch without travelling. They can share news, photos and voices as it happens.
These links can stretch across the world. A family in Sydney can talk often with relatives in another country, and distance does not stop the link.
draft.remember: Personal connections link people who know each other, and phones and online tools can carry them across any distance.

a.q: Which of these is a personal connection that works across a long distance?
opts: Aisha video calls her cousin who lives in Fiji
Aisha buys a book from a shop in her town
Aisha reads a news story about Fiji
Aisha walks past a stranger on her street
a.why: A video call links Aisha with a relative she knows, and the call works even though they are far apart. Buying a book and reading news do not link her with a person she knows, so they are not personal connections.
a.clue: Look for people who know each other and are in touch from far away.

b.q: Tom's best friend moves from Orange to a town overseas. How can they most likely stay connected?
opts: By messaging and video calling each other
By meeting in person at school each day
By waiting until they live in the same town
By stopping contact, as distance ends the link
b.why: Phone and online tools let friends keep in touch across any distance, so Tom and his friend can message and video call. Meeting at school each day is not possible after the move, and distance does not have to end a friendship.
b.clue: Think about how people keep in touch when they cannot meet face to face.

a.best: Aisha video calls her cousin who lives in Fiji

b.best: By messaging and video calling each other
